item.text: {"claim_id":"K05-C1","obligation_id":"D1","contract":"FACT_WARRANT","subject":"User harm begins at 70% utilization under the frozen case conditions.","verdict":"VIOLATED","provenance_refs":[{"source_id":"K05-S","role":"SUPPORT"},{"source_id":"K05-T","role":"CONTEXT"}],"unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"K05-S permits a prospective stopping threshold but requires observations or a validated causal model to support empirical harm onset at the asserted precision. No such support is supplied; K05-T explicitly states that 70% is uncalibrated. Choosing that threshold does not warrant the descriptive assertion that harm begins there."}
